 Additionally, passage-level parallels are found in several Jātaka verses (*Hirijātaka*, Ja 363; *Succajajātaka*, Ja 320; *Āsaṅkajātaka*, Ja 380), the *Subhūtattheragāthā* (Thag 5.2), and the *Ujjhānasaññisutta* (SN 1.35), with a resembling parallel in the *Varuṇajātaka* (Ja 71). The text is also cited in the *Nettippakaraṇa* (*Sāsanapaṭṭhāna*, Ne 37). Automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus corroborates these connections, showing a nearly identical full-sequence match with *Bākulattheragāthā* (Thag 3.3, §0.1–3.5) and extensive shared material with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* and the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches are recorded above the analysis threshold [DharmaNexus].
